header: The places a reader can join, and how busy each one is
lead: Forum, chat, user group, mailing list, code repository — one card per place, with what it is for and roughly how many people are there.
note: Member counts belong in each entry's description and go stale faster than anything else on the page: round them, or leave them out.

places.title: Two to six places
places.description: A card with a link becomes a link target as a whole, with the title carrying the accessible name.

places.title: Equal weight
places.description: A forum of a thousand and a meeting of nine are both simply somewhere to turn up, so neither is styled larger.

places.title: The size goes in the description
places.description: Not in the shared note, where it would claim to describe every place at once.

places.title: Two to four columns
places.description: And an optional image between the intro and the grid when the group has a photograph worth showing.
